text:
jamie: FYI - eu-north-1 p4d nodepool exhausted, autoscaler returning 'no capacity' and a big provisioner backlog. Started ~11:18. Seen from a research hyperparam sweep blasting 400+ GPU pods.

asim: on it, pulling provisioner and cloud-provider logs. ENI attach failures + subnet IP exhaustion in az-a looks like the immediate bottleneck. provisioner-bot: rate_limit_errors=312 in last 5m.

lina: can we reduce concurrency on that job? who owns the sweep? @marta?

marta: yep that's our sweep. It exploded after a config change (parallelism=50 -> 200). I paused new launches and scaled down the job controller. Sorry all.

ryan: quick mitigation plan: 1) cordon a subset of nodegroups to stop further GPU scheduling 2) drain lower-priority research pods (priorityClass=research-ephemeral) 3) fallback some requests to cpu-only nodes by mutating deployment for async offline batches.

jamie: doing (1) now. command: `kubectl cordon rg-p4d-eu-a-1` and apply taint `kubectl taint nodes rg-p4d-eu-a-1 dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule` to stop new pods.

asim: I've applied a temporary autoscaler config tweak — increased maxNodes for p4d pool by 20% and bumped scale-up burst to 30. Also reduced scaleDownDelay to 90s to free ephemeral capacity. Keep an eye on API rate limits.

provisioner-bot: applied patch to provisioner: backoff_window=30s, max_launches=8 concurrently. ENI queue depth drained from 120 -> 40 after backpressure throttle.

marta: draining low-priority pods now: `kubectl delete pod -l sweep=experiment-alpha --grace-period=0 --force` — freeing ~120 pod slots.

jamie: handing off cross-region fallback: routing policy updated to allow eu-west-1 as overflow for this customer/org. That will add latency but avoid total outage.

lina: cost alert — billing watch flagged a 3.6x GPU-spend spike in eu-north-1 for last hour. We should capture which jobs caused the spike and tag them for chargeback.

ryan: agreed. immediate cost stop-gap: enable model-quantization-preview on the research cluster (reduce resource/throughput) and throttle client-side concurrency to 10 per user.

asim: provisioning backlog is trending down. ENI attach errors decreased after releasing reserved subnets and bumping CIDR pool weights. Cloud provider still showing transient quota delay (~3m per allocation).

provisioner-bot: emergency capacity-reserve annotation added to rg-p4d-eu-a-standby: `inference.redwood/reserve=10` to keep warm nodes for low-latency fallbacks.

marta: the sweep owner pushed a new run with corrected parallelism=12 and is requeueing. we validated it against admission control to prevent another runaway.

jamie: status update: backlog cleared ~80%, p4d pool at 72% capacity used, autoscaler stabilized. Failover to eu-west reduced immediate pressure.

lina: follow-ups: 1) admission webhook to cap hyperparam-sweep concurrency per org 2) add admission metric to cost dashboards 3) pre-warm a small burst pool for experiments 4) add docs for research teams about gated-rollouts.

ryan: creating ticket for policy/enforcement + tagging owners. Also recommend a short RFC for 'sweep-safety' defaults (max concurrent GPU pods, default priorityClass, and warm-reserve).

jamie: closing loop — if anything regresses ping me with @jamie and escalate to SRE oncall. Great job moving fast, especially on the subnet/CIDR fixes. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident incident-1766554444 marked RESOLVED -> MONITORING. Postmortem requested by ops within 24h.
